name: – Andrzej Halicki – After § 7 – Am 5
title: REPORT on the Council position on Draft amending budget No 1/2026 of the European Union for the financial year 2026 entering the surplus of the financial year 2025
part_text: 7b. Recalls that, as of 31 December 2025, according to the European Public Prosecutor's Office Annual Report 2025, fraud affecting revenue, in particular VAT and customs duties, accounted for an estimated damage of EUR 45,01 billion, based solely on the estimated damage in cases subject to ongoing investigations;
